sources.access_detail: a digital copy (available on request); access check: a digital copy exists, behind a library sign-in
sources.note: Ch. 4 'La fonología de la LSM' (pp. 257-450) describes the segmental matrix (movement/hold segments), handshape/location/orientation features, non-manual features, bimanual signs, monosyllabic and polysyllabic sign schemes (4.5) and phonological processes; it contains no section or statement on stress, accent or prominence. 'Acento' appears only in reports of the ASL literature (Liddell 2003 on suprasegmentals in signed discourse, p. 41; Brentari/Perlmutter/Sandler on ASL syllables and stress, p. 409; Zeshan 2002 on compounds, p. 467).
